rationale: durable-execution integration options without forcing one backend now
allows canonical authority to remain in project-owned deterministic governance code
primary_runtime_decision.non_authority_rule: PydanticAI provides model/tool runtime mechanics only. It does not define A0-A10 authority, Risk/Security veto, Task Contracts or Human Gates.

caveats: greater orchestration complexity than current scope requires
do not introduce unless measured workflow complexity justifies it
larger framework/hosting surface than current private-system needs
Azure/Durable Task choices not justified at P02 baseline
unnecessary implementation burden for tools, models, approvals, typed outputs, tracing and durable mechanics
candidate_dispositions.replacement: Keep only a thin project-owned Governance Kernel around PydanticAI.

responsibilities: load active Task Contract and lock/gate state
model fallback mechanics where policy allows

runtime_components.rule: Agent consensus, model output or A0 routing cannot override a veto.
Checkpoint state is workflow state, not canonical market/account/order truth.
Framework-specific tracing may enrich but cannot be the sole audit source.
Model selection never changes agent authority or evidence independence by itself.

before_tool_or_write: task state READY/ACTIVE and valid lock where required
specialist contract permits capability if specialist
required Human Gate approval exists and matches exact action
A5 Risk policy permits financial/action path where applicable
after_tool: scan for prompt-injection/tool-instruction content when external/untrusted
authorization_pipeline.rule: Tool availability is never treated as permission.

agent_roles.A0: Governance / Orchestrator; routes and enforces task bounds; cannot bypass gates/vetoes.
agent_roles.A1: Architecture; interfaces/runtime design; no trading authority.
agent_roles.A2: Data; canonical data/provenance operations; no execution.
agent_roles.A3: Market Intelligence; evidence synthesis; no execution.
agent_roles.A4: Quant; models/backtests/calibration; no self-promotion to Live.
agent_roles.A5: Risk; independent binding veto/reduction; no broker submission.
agent_roles.A6: Execution; consumes only deterministic approved execution contracts; cannot override Risk/Firewall.
agent_roles.A8: Security; access/tool/security veto and quarantine authority; no trade decision.
agent_roles.A9: Operations; health/degraded/recovery control; cannot change risk ceilings.
agent_roles.A10: Evidence/Audit; trace/closure validation; no business/action authority.

specialist_lifecycle.spawn_authority: A0 or explicitly authorized core parent

message_envelope.required_usage: All production-relevant handoffs use typed/schema-validated envelopes or typed domain-specific supersets.
message_envelope.rule: Natural-language handoff text alone is not sufficient for material actions.

checkpoint_policy.integrity: schema-versioned + integrity metadata; corrupted/untrusted checkpoint fails closed

veto_integration.consensus_rule: Majority/agent consensus cannot override deterministic veto.

rules: approval is bound to the exact action digest/scope
approval does not grant unrelated future authority
tool annotations/descriptions treated as untrusted unless server is trusted
remote authorization uses least-privilege scopes and resource/audience validation
sensitive operations require project policy/Human Gate approval where configured
tool output is untrusted data until validated
tool_and_mcp_boundary.source_basis: MCP current specification explicitly recommends user control, access controls, input/output validation, timeouts and tool-use audit.

a2a_boundary.reason: A0-A10 are internal governed roles inside one system and do not currently require network agent-to-agent discovery/interoperability.
adoption_trigger: clear need for Agent Card/task protocol across network trust boundaries

untrusted_content_security.rule: External text/data never becomes agent policy or tool authority.
sources: repository content outside trusted policy paths
controls: separate system/task policy from retrieved content
tool call policy enforcement independent of model text

quarantine_triggers: repeated model/tool failure beyond circuit threshold
quarantine_behavior: require explicit health/security clearance before READY
health_quarantine.degraded_behavior: Use reduced capability/read-only/information-only path or fail closed according to contract.

observability_budgets.tracing: OpenTelemetry-compatible canonical tracing; framework tracing optional enrichment.

model_routing.fallback: Allowed only under policy and recorded with model identity/version.
model_routing.authority_rule: Fallback/model change does not expand tools, resources or role authority.
model_routing.evidence_independence_rule: Different personas or models are not automatically independent evidence; independence must be empirically/architecturally justified.

runtime_replay_recovery.recovery_rule: On resume, revalidate all freshness/permission/security/risk-sensitive state before continuing.
runtime_replay_recovery.side_effect_rule: Side-effecting tools require idempotency-aware retry semantics; uncertain side effects are reconciled before retry.

p04_handoff: pin exact PydanticAI version and license
define package lock and Python runtime version
do not install LangGraph/Microsoft/OpenAI Agents SDK unless a bounded justified task requires them

research_evidence.finding: Typed dependency injection/output models, MCP, approval-required/deferred tools and Temporal durable integration are documented.

research_evidence.source: Context7 / OpenAI Agents SDK v0.7.0 docs
research_evidence.finding: Handoffs, guardrails, human tool approvals, tracing and configurable models are documented.
Typed graph state, interrupts, checkpoint durability, subgraphs and resume are documented.
Workflows, checkpoints/resume, human-in-loop and durable/self-hosted execution are documented; capability breadth exceeds current minimal needs.

Tool annotations are untrusted unless from trusted servers; servers validate/access-control/rate-limit/sanitize; clients validate results, use timeouts, audit, and obtain control/approval for sensitive operations.
A2A provides network agent discovery/auth/task lifecycle; not required for current internal single-system role architecture.
